title: Present a repository through a recorded walkthrough
purpose: Compose independently governed capabilities to produce a proven repository walkthrough recording.
trigger: a repository walkthrough request is submitted
desiredOutcome: a recording and proof establish that the declared repository story was visibly presented
constraints: composition uses published capability contracts only
capability-specific decisions remain within the capability that owns their meaning
no recording is declared proven from artifact existence alone
all effects are authorized before execution and represented in receipts
